node.statement: Amplification and containment bounds: by def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra, A_n is an epsilon-C*-algebra, I_n tensor(-) preserves the relevant products, involution, and norm; hence each R_n for R in {P_1,P,Q_1,Q} is a delta-projection. Moreover P_nP_{1,n}-P_{1,n}=I_n tensor(PP_1-P_1)=I_n tensor(P_1P-P_1)^dagger has norm at most delta, while Q_{1,n}Q_n-Q_{1,n}=I_n tensor(Q_1Q-Q_1) has norm at most delta.
